description: Source file implementing methods for the ResolvedTargetData class, managing target information, dependencies, and build configurations in a build system.

classes.name: TargetInfo
classes.description: Structure holding detailed information about a build target, including dependencies, libraries, frameworks, and language-specific data.

methods.name: GetTargetInfo
methods.description: Retrieves or creates TargetInfo for a given target, with thread-safe locking.

methods.name: ComputeLibInfo
methods.description: Calculates and populates library directories and files for a target, including dependencies.

methods.name: ComputeFrameworkInfo
methods.description: Calculates and populates framework directories and frameworks for a target, including dependencies.

methods.name: ComputeHardDeps
methods.description: Determines and sets the set of hard dependencies for a target.

methods.name: ComputeInheritedLibs
methods.description: Computes and sets inherited libraries for a target based on dependencies.

methods.name: ComputeInheritedLibsFor
methods.description: Helper to compute inherited libraries for specific dependency sets.

methods.name: ComputeModuleDepsInformation
methods.description: Calculates module dependency information for a target.

methods.name: ComputeModuleDepsInformationFor
methods.description: Helper to compute module dependencies for specific dependency sets.

methods.name: ComputeRustLibs
methods.description: Calculates Rust libraries associated with a target.

methods.name: ComputeRustLibsFor
methods.description: Helper to compute Rust libraries for specific dependencies.

methods.name: ComputeSwiftValues
methods.description: Calculates Swift module information for a target.
